$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
SOURCE='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
test -f "$SOURCE"
printf 'CHECK_SOURCE '; sha256sum "$SOURCE"
test "$(sha256sum "$SOURCE" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = '429c0a45293e64de09f8da94e795c088e53afbd023337af3a59e344776412c2d'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-iteration-venv
/tmp/fishfry-iteration-venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry-iteration-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
original=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png')
image=Image.open(original).convert('RGB')
W,H=image.size
assert (W,H)==(1536,1476)
current=image.copy()
strip=image.copy()
expected={
 1:'54a7047049342d1fea774a845d06c5c97c4865b16951eac7c72c0b0ea0268673',
 2:'b9cb1070f6184f9b9f61b3f35e123e0651767e290101e73221d209fe9471be88',
 3:'d04714c925eac4da4d242126ba39c4ec5183524fb539134b4503d0708a87a4a7',
 4:'a09536de877579dd9937b9bca15b41805b24fdf2faf54f53aeaa6027cb802bb8',
 5:'f6e25ce0d75f5ec1d0c3acdc8cb6d9d3223888909d165964bbecd430f7df2df9',
 6:'759cc6f2683b8275da32345c08206144dc1d89c6b34afaa1d183afd149facdc2',
 7:'2d3905ac68f4731506aabae3c3c3b13d9827644a01be7acdb5c1996ed54f68c1',
 8:'7f21c241a6436f95c9e495d10b21b54212f628be23dbeb88be8cca98aee32ea3',
 9:'9ade1c59b48221ad3c266fe50151c8efe35655b3fddaa197cf8b61d2a2030684'}
for i in range(1,10):
 current=current.rotate(-5, resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, expand=False, fillcolor='white')
 out=Image.new('RGB',(W*(i+1),H),'white')
 out.paste(strip,(0,0))
 out.paste(current,(i*W,0))
 strip=out
 path=original.parent/f'pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_{i*5:02d}_step05.png'
 assert not path.exists(), path
 out.save(path,'PNG',compress_level=6)
 h=sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert h==expected[i],f'DIGEST_MISMATCH iteration {i}: {h}'
 print(f'VALIDATED_ITERATION {i} angle={i*5} size={out.width}x{out.height} sha256={h} file={path}',flush=True)
PY
git add -- terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_*_step05.png
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -c '^terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_')" -eq 9
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Publish nine cumulative five-degree fish fry rotation strips'
gh auth setup-git
git push origin HEAD:main
printf 'PUBLISHED_COMMIT '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'REMOTE_HEAD '; gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq '.object.sha'
printf 'PUBLISHED_PATHS\n'; git show --pretty='' --name-only HEAD | grep '^terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_'
outputThat: [main b7ced55] Publish nine cumulative five-degree fish fry rotation strips
